items.title: 'Israeli settlers laid siege to our home': Inside a Palestinian village under weekly attack
items.description: A home on the edge of al-Mughayyir has become a weekly frontline in the battle for the occupied West Bank.

items.title: After fleeing Sudan’s war, refugees battle thirst in Chad’s camps
items.description: After escaping war and atrocities, families now battle water shortages and fading hopes of returning home.

items.title: How Ukraine’s long-range drones are changing what’s possible in war with Russia
items.description: The latest story of the Ukraine war has been the shift – on the battlefield, and in the adversaries’ minds – wrought by Ukraine’s drone strikes deep into Russia. The goal is to pave a path to a diplomatic resolution.

items.title: Zelensky hails 'good meeting' in Washington with Trump on Patriot air defenses
items.description: Relations between Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Donald Trump have warmed since the start of the US president's second term, with Trump suggesting earlier this month that Ukrainian strikes inside Russia could help end the war.

Netanyahu to meet Trump in a first encounter since the Iran war began
items.description: The meeting comes as both face pressures at home. Netanyahu is up for reelection, embattled in part due to his deteriorating relationship with Trump. Trump is under pressure to end an unpopular war.

items.title: Montenegro Ends Visa-Free Entry for Russians Amid 2028 EU Membership Bid
items.description: Montenegro has remained one of the few European countries to offer visa-free entry to Russians for up to 30 days, and saw a massive influx of anti-war Russian citizens after the 2022 invasion of Ukraine.

items.description: Russian drone attacks are making it increasingly dangerous to deliver supplies to Ukraine's frontline troops. items.title: Sudan civil war: Civilians used as 'human shields'
items.description: The situation in the besieged city of El Obeid in Sudan is worsening by the day, with rights organizations warning of mass atrocities. Children are traumatized and do not dare go to school.
